name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Financial support of Rs 6,000 per year in three equal installments directly to bank accounts of landholding farmer families.
benefits: ₹6,000/year direct cash transfer (3 installments of ₹2,000 each)

criteria.description: Must have an active bank account
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant does not have a bank account for direct transfer

criteria.description: Must own cultivable agricultural land (at least 0.01 acres)
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant does not own cultivable agricultural land
